item.title: Does this image show creepy 'spider' on Mars?
item.description:
# Does this image show creepy 'spider' on Mars? ## Artificial intelligence had a hand in creating the image of the eight-armed "rock formation" on Mars. ### Published Aug. 23, 2026 An image authentically showed a “spider-shaped rock formation” on the surface of Mars.
Reputable media outlets might also have reported on it.
It was created using artificial intelligence tools.
However, Facebook marked [both](https://www.facebook.com/61554330324919/photos/a-strange-rock-on-mars-sparked-curiosity-after-its-leg-like-shape-resembled-a-gi/122261297732144344/) [postings](https://www.facebook.com/61563144540652/posts/a-bizarre-spider-like-rock-spotted-by-nasas-curiosity-rover-quickly-sparked-spec/122199182858438151/) we found on the platform as "AI Content." According to the platform, this is a label Facebook [applies to items](https://www.meta.com/en-gb/help/artificial-intelligence/1783222608822690/?fbclid=IwY2xjawTxpOJwZG9mAWV4dG4DYWVtAjEwAGJyaWQRMWpKTGthSGZ5NmFpWXFvcDRzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEeLUekKogoKtiCtS31ORogVJO6uRUQUOeH-2eIMhN0EgTX_MLoZK4LnMLGAfM_aem_FNE-9bb6osjmF5PBrZE-rg) when it identifies a signal added by the AI tool used to create the content. This could be digital watermarks like Google or OpenAI's [SynthID](https://deepmind.google/models/synthid/).
We uploaded the image into [Meta's AI identification tool](https://meta.ai/identification), which said it was created using its generative AI tools, further supporting our conclusion that it was fake.
For example, the image showed that the bottom of the "rover" in the image did not cast a shadow.
Additionally, the image text incorrectly translated Sols, meaning solar days on Mars.
#### Sources Meta, [https://www.meta.com/en-gb/help/artificial-intelligence/1783222608822690/?fbclid=IwY2xjawTxpOJwZG9mAWV4dG4DYWVtAjEwAGJyaWQRMWpKTGthSGZ5NmFpWXFvcDRzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEeLUekKogoKtiCtS31ORogVJO6uRUQUOeH-2eIMhN0EgTX\_MLoZK4LnMLGAfM\_aem\_FNE-9bb6osjmF5PBrZE-rg](https://www.meta.com/en-gb/help/artificial-intelligence/1783222608822690/?fbclid=IwY2xjawTxpOJwZG9mAWV4dG4DYWVtAjEwAGJyaWQRMWpKTGthSGZ5NmFpWXFvcDRzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEeLUekKogoKtiCtS31ORogVJO6uRUQUOeH-2eIMhN0EgTX\_MLoZK4LnMLGAfM\_aem\_FNE-9bb6osjmF5PBrZE-rg).

item.title: Artificial intelligence agents spontaneously conform to the majority opinion
item.description:
# Artificial intelligence agents spontaneously conform to the majority opinion Advanced artificial intelligence programs can spontaneously form a consensus by adopting the popular opinion, according to research published in the journal _Science Advances_.
Each agent received one of two random, neutral opinions.
The scientists found that advanced models like GPT-4 Turbo and Claude 3 Opus fully coordinated.
Just as atomic spins in a magnetic material tend to align with the majority of surrounding atoms, the artificial intelligence agents tended to align with the majority opinion.
“Our setup is deliberately minimal: two arbitrary options, no memory, no stakes, no correct answer,” De Marzo said.
